description: UPF measures how much UV passes through fabric. Learn what UPF 50 means, how wet or stretched fabric changes it and how to choose shirts and hats.
directAnswer: UPF 50 lets through about 2 percent of UV, blocking about 98 percent, but only for dry, unstretched fabric and only where it covers. Combine UPF clothing, a wide-brim hat and sunscreen on exposed skin.
